compute.cost_note: one variance_audit pass per text; tier 1 is stdlib, --tier2 needs spaCy

do_not_use_when: you have fewer than two pairs (signal SDs are undefined)
you want an authorship verdict; the match only says normal editing by this editor vs a different process

examples.description: Learn an editor profile from labeled pairs

inputs.target: learn: a pairs JSON (--pairs-json); match: --before, --after and a learned --profile

purpose: Learn an editorial transformation profile from labeled before/after pairs (learn mode: per-signal mean and SD of after-minus-before deltas), then match a new pair against it (match mode: per-signal z-scores and a matches_profile style verdict), so a known editor's ordinary pass is not mistaken for evidence about provenance.
use_when: you have several before/after pairs from the same editor and writer and want to know whether a new pass looks like that editor's normal work
